title: "Proteomics Analysis of MetS Groups (parallel to metabolomics pipeline)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Overview

This script mirrors the metabolomics MWAS / group-contrast / prediction
pipeline (`code/metabolomics/mets_group_analysis.Rmd`), applied to the **proteomics** dataset
instead. Since the Healthy/Mixed/Extreme `MetS_Group` classification was
derived from the metabolomics archetype results, it is brought across into
the proteomics dataset by matching on the shared ID column
`u3n_metabBiocrP500_ff4` present in both files.

Inputs:

- `Merged_proteomics_Data_soft.RData` -> object `Merged.proteomics.Data.soft`
  (private cohort, the proteins + clinical traits + the whole-population's own
  4-archetype decomposition)
- `Merged_Healthy_Mets_metabolites.RData` -> object `merged` (private cohort,
  already containing `MetS_Group`, `MetS_DominantArchetype`,
  `MetS_MaxArchetypeWeight` from the metabolomics pipeline)

```{r parameters}
path_proteomics <- "Merged.proteomics.Data.soft.RData"
path_metab_merged <- "merge_MetS_groups_vf_results/Merged_Metabolomics_Data_soft_WholePopulation_with_MetSGroup.RData"

id_col  <- "u3n_metabBiocrP500_ff4"   # shared ID column across both files
age_col <- "u3talteru"
sex_col <- "u3csex"

# All results/plots from this script are written here, in a folder specific
# to this RMD, so outputs from different analyses never collide.
output_dir <- "proteomics_MetS_analysis_results"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

## Load data and bring MetS_Group across into the proteomics dataset

```{r load-merge}
load(path_proteomics)     # loads: Merged.proteomics.Data.soft
load(path_metab_merged)   # loads: merged  (metabolomics pipeline output)
merged = Merged.Metabolomics.Data.soft.WholePopulation

prot_raw  <- Merged.proteomics.Data.soft
metab_grp <- merged[, c(id_col, "MetS_Group", "MetS_DominantArchetype",
                         "MetS_MaxArchetypeWeight")]

stopifnot(id_col %in% colnames(prot_raw))

prot <- merge(prot_raw, metab_grp, by = id_col, all.x = TRUE)

# Subjects with no metabolomics MetS classification (not in the metabolomics
# pipeline: anyone outside the MetS extreme-search subset is Healthy)
prot$MetS_Group <- factor(
  ifelse(is.na(prot$MetS_Group), "Healthy", as.character(prot$MetS_Group)),
  levels = c("Healthy", "Mixed", "Extreme")
)

cat("Proteomics subjects:", nrow(prot), "\n")
table(prot$MetS_Group)
cat("Matched a metabolomics MetS classification:",
    sum(!is.na(metab_grp$MetS_Group[match(prot[[id_col]], metab_grp[[id_col]])])), "\n")
```

## Sanity checks

```{r checks}
# Every subject that was Mixed/Extreme in the metabolomics merge should
# still be Mixed/Extreme here (no subjects gained/lost in translation),
# allowing for the small number of IDs that don't have a proteomics match
metab_non_healthy <- metab_grp[[id_col]][metab_grp$MetS_Group != "Healthy"]
metab_non_healthy <- metab_non_healthy[!is.na(metab_non_healthy)]
prot_non_healthy  <- prot[[id_col]][prot$MetS_Group != "Healthy"]

stopifnot(all(metab_non_healthy %in% prot_non_healthy[!is.na(prot_non_healthy)] |
              !(metab_non_healthy %in% prot[[id_col]])))

dim(prot)
table(prot$MetS_Group)
str(prot[, c(id_col, "MetS_Group", "MetS_DominantArchetype", "MetS_MaxArchetypeWeight")])
```

## Regression analysis setup

```{r reg-setup}
cols <- colnames(prot_raw)

# Protein columns: everything after the clinical/archetype block, identified
# by the sp__/tr__ UniProt-style naming convention used in this panel
protein_cols <- cols[grepl("^(sp|tr)__", cols)]

stopifnot(all(prot$u3tmsidfup %in% c(1, 2)))
prot$MetS_case <- as.integer(prot$u3tmsidfup == 1)
table(prot$MetS_case, prot$u3tmsidfup)

mets_traits <- c("u3tgewi","u3tgroe","u3tbmi","u3twhrat","u3tsysmm","u3tdiamm",
                 "u3tglukfastn","u3tgluk2n","u3tinsfastn","u3tins2n",
                 "u3thoma2_b","u3thoma2_s","u3thoma2_ir","u3tquickin",
                 "u3lk_choln","u3lk_hdln","u3lk_ldln","u3lk_trin","u3lk_krean",
                 "u3l_hbavn","u3h_crp","MetS_case")
stopifnot(all(mets_traits %in% colnames(prot)))

length(protein_cols)  # number of proteins
length(mets_traits)   # number of clinical traits

get_term_stats <- function(fit, term) {
  s <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  if (!term %in% rownames(s)) return(c(beta = NA, se = NA, p = NA))
  c(beta = s[term, 1], se = s[term, 2], p = s[term, 4])
}

# Full set of clinical traits used to define the MetS extreme-search
# subclustering (archetype decomposition), kept here as a code -> readable
# label dictionary. mets_traits above still drives the models actually
# fitted below; this is used purely to relabel plots/tables with
# human-readable trait names instead of raw variable codes.
traits = c(
    Age = "u3talteru",
    Gender = "u3csex",
    Weight = "u3tgewi",
    Height = "u3tgroe",
    BMI = "u3tbmi",
    WHO_BMI_Category = "u3tbmiwho",
    WHR = "u3twhrat",
    WHR_Category = "u3twhratc",
    SBP = "u3tsysmm",
    DBP = "u3tdiamm",
    Hypertension = "u3twhoish",
    Fasting_glucose = "u3tglukfastn",
    Glucose_2h = "u3tgluk2n",
    Diabetes_WHO = "u3tdm110y15",
    Fasting_serum_insulin = "u3tinsfastn",
    Insulin_2h = "u3tins2n",
    Metabolic_Syndrome_IDF = "u3tmsidfup",
    HOMA_Beta = "u3thoma2_b",
    HOMA_Sensitivity = "u3thoma2_s",
    HOMA_IR = "u3thoma2_ir",
    Insulin_Sensitivity_Quicki = "u3tquickin",
    Cholesterol = "u3lk_choln",
    HDL = "u3lk_hdln",
    LDL = "u3lk_ldln",
    TG = "u3lk_trin",
    Creatinine = "u3lk_krean",
    HbA1c = "u3l_hbavn",
    hsCRP = "u3h_crp"
  )
trait_label_lookup <- setNames(names(traits), traits)
trait_label_lookup["MetS_case"] <- "MetS_case"  # derived variable, not in `traits`

trait_label <- function(code) {
  lbl <- trait_label_lookup[code]
  ifelse(is.na(lbl), code, lbl)
}
```

For every protein x clinical trait pair, fit:

`protein ~ trait + age + sex`

P-values are FDR (Benjamini-Hochberg) corrected within each trait.

```{r step1-pwas}
run_pwas_continuous <- function(data, proteins, trait, age_col, sex_col, extra_covars = NULL) {
  covars <- c(trait, age_col, sex_col, extra_covars)
  out <- vector("list", length(proteins))
  for (i in seq_along(proteins)) {
    pr <- proteins[i]
    form <- as.formula(paste0("`", pr, "` ~ ", paste(covars, collapse = " + ")))
    fit <- lm(form, data = data)
    st <- get_term_stats(fit, trait)
    out[[i]] <- data.frame(protein = pr, trait = trait,
                            beta = st["beta"], se = st["se"], p = st["p"],
                            n = nobs(fit))
  }
  do.call(rbind, out)
}

pwas_list    <- lapply(mets_traits, function(tr)
                  run_pwas_continuous(prot, protein_cols, tr, age_col, sex_col))
pwas_results <- do.call(rbind, pwas_list)
rownames(pwas_results) <- NULL

pwas_results$q <- NA_real_
for (tr in mets_traits) {
  idx <- pwas_results$trait == tr
  pwas_results$q[idx] <- p.adjust(pwas_results$p[idx], method = "BH")
}

cat("Total protein-trait tests:", nrow(pwas_results), "\n")
cat("Significant at FDR q < 0.05:", sum(pwas_results$q < 0.05),
    sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n", 100 * mean(pwas_results$q < 0.05)))

for (tr in c("u3lk_trin", "u3lk_hdln", "u3tbmi", "u3tglukfastn", "u3h_crp", "MetS_case")) {
  cat("\nTop hits for", trait_label(tr), "(", tr, "):\n")
  sub <- pwas_results[pwas_results$trait == tr, ]
  print(head(sub[order(sub$p), c("protein","beta","p","q")], 5), row.names = FALSE)
}

write.csv(pwas_results, file.path(output_dir, "step1_protein_trait_associations.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r step1b-plot-volcano}
sub$direction <- with(sub, ifelse(q >= 0.05, "Not significant",
                            ifelse(beta > 0, "Positive (q < 0.05)", "Negative (q < 0.05)")))
```

For every protein, fit `protein ~ MetS_Group + age + sex` and extract each
group's contrast vs. Healthy. FDR correction applied across all tested
proteins, separately for each contrast.

```{r step2-group}
run_group_contrast <- function(data, features, ref_level, age_col, sex_col) {
  d <- data
  d$MetS_Group <- relevel(d$MetS_Group, ref = ref_level)
  out <- vector("list", length(features))
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    ft <- features[i]
    form <- as.formula(paste0("`", ft, "` ~ MetS_Group + ", age_col, " + ", sex_col))
    fit <- lm(form, data = d)
    row <- data.frame(protein = ft)
    for (lvl in setdiff(levels(d$MetS_Group), ref_level)) {
      term <- paste0("MetS_Group", lvl)
      st <- get_term_stats(fit, term)
      row[[paste0("beta_", lvl, "_vs_", ref_level)]] <- st["beta"]
      row[[paste0("se_",   lvl, "_vs_", ref_level)]] <- st["se"]
      row[[paste0("p_",    lvl, "_vs_", ref_level)]] <- st["p"]
    }
    out[[i]] <- row
  }
  do.call(rbind, out)
}

group_results <- run_group_contrast(prot, protein_cols, "Healthy", age_col, sex_col)

group_results$q_Mixed_vs_Healthy   <- p.adjust(group_results$p_Mixed_vs_Healthy,   method = "BH")
group_results$q_Extreme_vs_Healthy <- p.adjust(group_results$p_Extreme_vs_Healthy, method = "BH")

cat("Significant (q<0.05) Mixed vs Healthy:",   sum(group_results$q_Mixed_vs_Healthy   < 0.05), "\n")
cat("Significant (q<0.05) Extreme vs Healthy:", sum(group_results$q_Extreme_vs_Healthy < 0.05), "\n")

cat("\nTop hits, Mixed vs Healthy:\n")
print(head(group_results[order(group_results$p_Mixed_vs_Healthy),
      c("protein","beta_Mixed_vs_Healthy","q_Mixed_vs_Healthy")], 8), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nTop hits, Extreme vs Healthy:\n")
print(head(group_results[order(group_results$p_Extreme_vs_Healthy),
      c("protein","beta_Extreme_vs_Healthy","q_Extreme_vs_Healthy")], 8), row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(group_results, file.path(output_dir, "step2_protein_group_associations.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

Mirrors Step 6 of the metabolomics pipeline: cross-validated logistic
regression (base R only), comparing protein-based prediction to age+sex
alone, across the three pairwise group comparisons.

```{r step4-predict-setup}
# Mann-Whitney based AUC (no pROC/ROCR needed)
auc_fn <- function(prob, label) {
  pos <- prob[label == 1]; neg <- prob[label == 0]
  n1 <- length(pos); n0 <- length(neg)
  r <- rank(c(pos, neg))
  (sum(r[1:n1]) - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2) / (n1 * n0)
}

# k-fold stratified CV logistic regression with per-fold univariate feature screening
run_cv_logistic <- function(data, outcome_col, pos_label, metabolites, covars,
                             k_top = 8, n_folds = 10, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  d <- data
  y <- as.integer(d[[outcome_col]] == pos_label)
  n <- nrow(d)
  folds <- integer(n)
  for (lab in unique(y)) {
    idx <- which(y == lab)
    folds[idx] <- sample(rep(1:n_folds, length.out = length(idx)))
  }
  oof_pred <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  fold_feats <- vector("list", n_folds)
  for (f in 1:n_folds) {
    train_idx <- which(folds != f); test_idx <- which(folds == f)
    train <- d[train_idx, ]; test <- d[test_idx, ]
    ytr <- y[train_idx]
    if (k_top > 0) {
      pvals <- sapply(metabolites, function(mb) {
        fit <- tryCatch(stats::glm(ytr ~ train[[mb]], family = binomial), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (is.null(fit)) return(1)
        s <- summary(fit)$coefficients
        if (nrow(s) < 2) return(1)
        s[2, 4]
      })
      top_feats <- names(sort(pvals))[1:min(k_top, length(pvals))]
    } else {
      top_feats <- character(0)
    }
    fold_feats[[f]] <- top_feats
    form <- as.formula(paste("y_tr ~", paste(c(top_feats, covars), collapse = " + ")))
    train_df <- train[, c(top_feats, covars), drop = FALSE]
    train_df$y_tr <- ytr
    fit <- suppressWarnings(stats::glm(form, data = train_df, family = binomial))
    test_df <- test[, c(top_feats, covars), drop = FALSE]
    oof_pred[test_idx] <- suppressWarnings(stats::predict.glm(fit, newdata = test_df, type = "response"))
  }
  list(pred = oof_pred, y = y, auc = auc_fn(oof_pred, y), fold_feats = fold_feats)
}
covars <- c(age_col, sex_col)
```

```{r step4-predict-run}
em_subset <- prot[prot$MetS_Group %in% c("Mixed", "Extreme"), ]
em_subset$MetS_Group <- factor(em_subset$MetS_Group, levels = c("Mixed", "Extreme"))

eh_subset <- prot[prot$MetS_Group %in% c("Healthy", "Extreme"), ]
eh_subset$MetS_Group <- factor(eh_subset$MetS_Group, levels = c("Healthy", "Extreme"))

mh_subset <- prot[prot$MetS_Group %in% c("Healthy", "Mixed"), ]
mh_subset$MetS_Group <- factor(mh_subset$MetS_Group, levels = c("Healthy", "Mixed"))

comparisons <- list(
  list(name = "Extreme vs Mixed",   data = em_subset, pos = "Extreme"),
  list(name = "Extreme vs Healthy", data = eh_subset, pos = "Extreme"),
  list(name = "Mixed vs Healthy",   data = mh_subset, pos = "Mixed")
)

pred_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(comparisons, function(cmp) {
  full_model <- run_cv_logistic(cmp$data, "MetS_Group", cmp$pos, protein_cols, covars, k_top = 8)
  prot_only  <- run_cv_logistic(cmp$data, "MetS_Group", cmp$pos, protein_cols, character(0), k_top = 8)
  baseline   <- run_cv_logistic(cmp$data, "MetS_Group", cmp$pos, protein_cols, covars, k_top = 0)
  data.frame(
    comparison        = cmp$name,
    n                  = nrow(cmp$data),
    auc_prot_age_sex   = round(full_model$auc, 3),
    auc_prot_only      = round(prot_only$auc, 3),
    auc_age_sex_only   = round(baseline$auc, 3)
  )
}))

print(pred_results, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(pred_results, file.path(output_dir, "step4_protein_prediction_auc_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

Counts how often each protein was selected across the 10 CV folds
(stability selection), and reports effect size (OR, p, FDR q) from a single
age/sex-adjusted model on the full comparison-specific dataset.

```{r step5-stability-selection}
get_adj_univariate <- function(data, outcome_col, pos_label, feature, covars) {
  y <- as.integer(data[[outcome_col]] == pos_label)
  df <- data[, c(feature, covars)]
  df$y <- y
  form <- as.formula(paste("y ~", paste(c(feature, covars), collapse = " + ")))
  fit <- glm(form, data = df, family = binomial)
  s <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  c(OR = exp(s[feature, 1]), p = s[feature, 4])
}

posthoc_results <- list()
for (cmp in comparisons) {
  r <- run_cv_logistic(cmp$data, "MetS_Group", cmp$pos, protein_cols, covars, k_top = 8)
  freq <- sort(table(unlist(r$fold_feats)), decreasing = TRUE)
  top_n <- names(freq)[1:min(8, length(freq))]

  tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(top_n, function(ft) {
    st <- get_adj_univariate(cmp$data, "MetS_Group", cmp$pos, ft, covars)
    data.frame(protein = ft,
               times_selected_of_10 = as.integer(freq[ft]),
               OR = round(st["OR"], 3),
               p  = signif(st["p"], 3))
  }))
  tab$q <- round(p.adjust(tab$p, method = "BH"), 4)
  posthoc_results[[cmp$name]] <- tab

  cat("\n---", cmp$name, ": top proteins driving the prediction ---\n")
  print(tab, row.names = FALSE)
}

write.csv(do.call(rbind, lapply(names(posthoc_results), function(nm) {
  cbind(comparison = nm, posthoc_results[[nm]])
})), file.path(output_dir, "step5_posthoc_predictive_proteins.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r step5-stability-plot, fig.height=6}
  barplot(tab$times_selected_of_10, names.arg = tab$protein, horiz = TRUE,
          las = 1, col = "steelblue", xlim = c(0, 10),
          main = paste0(nm, ": protein selection frequency (10 CV folds)"),
          xlab = "Times selected across 10 folds",
          cex.names = 0.7, cex.axis = 1.1, cex.lab = 1.2, cex.main = 1.1,
          space = 0.6)
}
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

dev.off()
```




```{r step7-stability-plot, fig.height=8}
 library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(ggpubr)

mets_colors <- c("Healthy" = "gray", "Mixed" = "orange", "Extreme" = "red")

# Read the saved post-hoc table
posthoc_csv <- read.csv("proteomics_MetS_analysis_results/step5_posthoc_predictive_proteins.csv",
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Use `prot` -- the proteomics data frame, which already has MetS_Group attached
# (NOT `merged`, which is the metabolomics table and has no protein columns)
em_subset <- prot[prot$MetS_Group %in% c("Mixed", "Extreme"), ]
em_subset$MetS_Group <- factor(em_subset$MetS_Group, levels = c("Mixed", "Extreme"))

eh_subset <- prot[prot$MetS_Group %in% c("Healthy", "Extreme"), ]
eh_subset$MetS_Group <- factor(eh_subset$MetS_Group, levels = c("Healthy", "Extreme"))

mh_subset <- prot[prot$MetS_Group %in% c("Healthy", "Mixed"), ]
mh_subset$MetS_Group <- factor(mh_subset$MetS_Group, levels = c("Healthy", "Mixed"))

comparison_data <- list(
  "Extreme vs Mixed"   = em_subset,
  "Extreme vs Healthy" = eh_subset,
  "Mixed vs Healthy"   = mh_subset
)

# Clean protein/gene symbol for facet labels (same helper used earlier)
extract_protein_name <- function(x) {
  sapply(x, function(id) {
    first_id <- sub("___.*$", "", id)
    parts    <- strsplit(first_id, "__", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    name     <- parts[length(parts)]
    sub("_HUMAN$", "", name)
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

posthoc_boxplot_list <- list()

for (cmp_name in unique(posthoc_csv$comparison)) {
  top_n <- posthoc_csv$protein[posthoc_csv$comparison == cmp_name]
  cmp_data <- comparison_data[[cmp_name]]

  missing_cols <- setdiff(top_n, colnames(cmp_data))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    warning("Skipping missing columns for ", cmp_name, ": ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
    top_n <- setdiff(top_n, missing_cols)
  }

  plot_df <- cmp_data[, c(top_n, "MetS_Group")]
  plot_long <- pivot_longer(plot_df, cols = all_of(top_n),
                             names_to = "Protein", values_to = "Level")

  plot_long$ProteinLabel <- extract_protein_name(plot_long$Protein)
  plot_long$ProteinLabel <- factor(plot_long$ProteinLabel,
                                    levels = unique(extract_protein_name(top_n)))

  p <- ggplot(plot_long, aes(x = MetS_Group, y = Level, fill = MetS_Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.6, alpha = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~ ProteinLabel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mets_colors) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.format", size = 3) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Protein level",
         title = paste0("Top stability-selected proteins: ", cmp_name))

  print(p)
  posthoc_boxplot_list[[cmp_name]] <- p

  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("step5_boxplots_", gsub(" ", "_", cmp_name), ".png")),
         plot = p, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 600)
}
``` 
